Ari: flagging an odd bump in our weekly KPI card after the product launch + webinar combo. public view link: https://dash.redwood-inference.com/marketing/kpis/launch-week
Becca: seeing it too. looks like registrations spiked but SQLs didn't. could be duplicate registration events or bad UTM parsing.
Samir: quick sanity check: ran a dedupe on email + session_id for the last 7 days. query returned 47 duplicate entries. snippet: SELECT email, COUNT(*) FROM staging.regs WHERE created_at > '2026-04-10' GROUP BY email, session_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;
Nina: Metrics-Bot: ETL job marketing.normalize_utms v2026-04-12 started. Expected finish: 20m.
Becca: recommendation: hold the exec KPI slide until we confirm. we should publish both "raw" and "deduped (first_touch)" numbers and call out the adjustment.
Ari: agree. Samir can you create a deduped dataset tag and preserve the raw table? also ping sales/cs so they're not exporting the raw CSV.
Samir: done. created marketing.regs_dedup_20260412 (tag: v2026-04-12-1) and preserved marketing.regs_raw_20260412. pinged #sales-ops with a heads-up.
Metrics-Bot: ETL job complete. Rows normalized: 7,942. Duplicates removed: 47.
Becca: updating the deck now — adding an appendix slide that shows: raw vs deduped vs first_touch numbers + short note on partner redirect issue.
Nina: I'll add a dashboard annotation: "Adjusted for duplicate registrations and UTM normalization (see dataset v2026-04-12-1)."
Ari: perfect. we'll publish the annotated KPI deck after 11:00 PT. thanks team. :white_check_mark:
